description: A `<db>` body holding a type, a function, markup and a display-text literal: the button in the block calls the block's function; the literal renders in place. Nothing in the body ships as page text.
rationale: RULED S472 item 3: "The `<db>` body is code-default and ITEM-ONLY (declarations, `function`/`fn`, `type`, markup, `"…"` literals)".
